address: 78/1 Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand
bio: Easy to spot with its white façade and striking blue doors, this restaurant near Lanna Golf has a welcoming decor of wood, exposed brick and inviting lighting. The kitchen delivers well-executed Thai dishes – tom som kung ma now, Jaan Joor stir-fried beef, and the standout stir-fried prawns with roasted chilli paste and prawn oil. Expect generous portions made for sharing; it's excellent value, given the quality. Ample parking makes it a convenient option.
